name: Message in a Bottle
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The note reads, in fairly good handwriting:

To any that can aid me-

Please, my need for help is dire. A great Skymane holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.

The stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see Wild Shore to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.

I beg of you, my would-be savior, please help me.
narrative.objectives: Find the author of the message in a bottle.
narrative.offerRewardText: Have you come to free me?
